items.title: Claude Opus 5.5
items.whyItMatters: Opus 5.5 brings the biggest jump in quality-to-cost yet; the price analysis on Artificial Analysis breaks down what that means for inference budgets.

items.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
items.whyItMatters: GPT-6 ships with two variants — Sol for quality, Luna for speed — a new stratified release model that could simplify model selection.

items.title: Pentagon says overreliance on AI contributed to missile strike on Iran school
items.whyItMatters: A Pentagon report credits AI overreliance in a real combat decision — the kind of case study that's going to shape procurement for years.

items.title: OpenAI GPT–6 Astra breaks Enigma message that has resisted solution since 2005
items.whyItMatters: GPT-6 Astra cracked a cryptographic message that held since 2005, showing a new kind of symbolic-reasoning capability beyond pattern matching.

items.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats
items.whyItMatters: Claude found a genuinely novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats — not just summarizing papers but contributing to the scientific record.
